note: A rule CHECKS a value; it never supplies one. `check` is an expression of the kernel's language over spec keys in canonical millimetres (levels = RL × 1000) returning 1 (holds) or 0; ge/le/gt/lt are the kernel's comparison functions. `applies` says to what (families, components that must exist, the work's status); `requires` are the inputs without which the rule is NOT EVALUATED (with the gap reason). What a violation means follows from the rule's status and its best source's trust (knowledge-registry.ts `ruleSeverity`): NORMATIVE + VERIFIED_LOCAL → FAIL (REQUIRES REVIEW when `relaxable`); SECONDARY sources → REQUIRES REVIEW at most; DERIVED consistency → FAIL; ASSUMPTION / COMMON_PRACTICE → INFO; UNKNOWN / DISPUTED → never evaluated, listed. A validator reports; nothing here moves geometry.

rules.title: Minimum clear span 1 m
rules.statement: New bridges and rebuilt bridges on existing lines have a clear span of at least 1 m.

interpretation.pipe: IRBM 311(3) does not say how a pipe's clear span is measured — REQUIRES_ENGINEER_INPUT to apply it to a pipe

rules.title: Minimum headroom 1.2 m (relaxable)
rules.relaxable: Principal Chief Engineer / Chief Bridge Engineer may relax it (heavy expenditure, regrading, construction difficulty)
rules.statement: New bridges have a headroom of at least 1.2 m for inspection and maintenance.

rules.title: Vertical clearance above the design water level (by discharge)
rules.relaxable: PCE / CBE under 312(4), within the reduced table
rules.statement: Soffit minus the water level of the design discharge incl. afflux: 600 mm for 0–30 m³/s, 600–1200 pro rata for 31–300, 1500 for 301–3000, 1800 above.

rules.title: Arch clearance to the crown of the intrados
rules.statement: Clearance to the crown of the intrados: span < 4 m rise or 1200 mm; 4–7 m 2/3 rise or 1500; 7.1–20 m 2/3 rise or 1800 (whichever more); > 20 m 2/3 rise.
rules.check: ge(crown_level - design_water_level, if(lt(clear_span, 4000), max(rise, 1200), if(le(clear_span, 7000), max(2 * rise / 3, 1500), if(le(clear_span, 20000), max(2 * rise / 3, 1800), 2 * rise / 3))))

rules.title: Pipe and box culverts: no vertical clearance (pressure conduits)
rules.statement: Syphons, pipe and box culverts are designed as pressure conduits; no clearance is required for them.

rules.title: Free board ≥ 1 m from the design water level (relaxable)
rules.relaxable: PCE / CBE under 313(2): 600 mm below 3 m³/s, 750 mm for 3–30 m³/s, no relaxation above 30; existing free board may be retained for extensions (313(3))
rules.statement: Free board from the water level of the design discharge incl. afflux to the formation is not less than 1 m.

proxy.note: the drawing gives the HFL, not the design-discharge water level incl. afflux (KC-6): evaluated against the HFL as an indication only — REQUIRES REVIEW, never a pass

rules.title: Pipe / box culverts not where the bed is likely to scour
rules.statement: Pipe and box culverts on open foundations are built on a levelled, consolidated bed with lean concrete, and should not normally be provided where the bed is likely to be scoured.

rules.title: Open foundation ≥ 1.75 m below the scoured bed (ordinary soil)
rules.statement: Other bridges on open foundations go at least 1.75 m below the lowest anticipated scoured bed level in ordinary soil; in rock, keyed 0.3 m (hard) or 1.5 m (soft).

rules.title: Masonry pier batter 1 in 24 to 1 in 12
rules.statement: Masonry piers have a batter from 1 in 24 to 1 in 12.

rules.title: Masonry abutment front batter 1 in 16 to 1 in 10
rules.statement: Masonry abutments have a front batter of 1 in 16 to 1 in 10; flatter slopes or steps at the rear as designed.

rules.title: Boulder filling behind abutments and wing walls ≥ 600 mm
rules.statement: Behind abutments and wing walls, boulder filling of not less than 600 mm and granular backfill (GW, GP, SW per IS 1498) for the full height.

interpretation.rcc_box: 605(3) is written for abutments and wing walls; applying it to the backing of a box's outer wall is for the engineer to confirm
interpretation.pipe: 605(3) is written for abutments and wing walls

rules.title: Weep holes 1 m × 1 m staggered; lowest row placement
rules.statement: Weep holes at 1 m vertical and 1 m horizontal, staggered, in abutments, wing and return walls; the bottom row above LWL in flowing streams, 250 mm above bed otherwise, above FSL in canals.

rules.title: Skew advisably ≤ 30°
rules.statement: Where a skew crossing is unavoidable, it is advisable to restrict the skew to 30°.

rules.title: Box and pipe culverts need not be analysed for seismic forces
rules.statement: Box and pipe culverts need not be analysed for seismic forces.

rules.title: Masonry / plain concrete arches > 12 m not in zones IV and V
rules.statement: BS-118 4.3: masonry and plain concrete arches over 12 m span are not built in zones IV and V (the 2020 code, not in hand, is said to differ).

rules.title: Minimum seating width at supports
rules.statement: Seating width: BS-118 14.3 (300 + 1.5L + 6Hp zones II/III; 500 + 2.5L + 10Hp IV/V) against the IRS Seismic Code 2020 values (not in hand) — which edition governs is not established.

rules.title: RCC box span > 3 m needs CAO(C) / CBE approval
rules.statement: RCC boxes for minor bridges up to 3 m span with adequate cushion; larger spans need CAO(C)/CBE approval (IRCM, quoted by a secondary source).

rules.title: Multi-cell box: RDSO standard or specially designed, with approval
rules.statement: Side-by-side boxes are not permitted except RDSO standard or specially designed multi-cell boxes with approval (IRCM, quoted by a secondary source).

rules.title: Rail over formation (0.762 m is an assumption)
rules.statement: Rail level minus formation level depends on the rail, sleeper and ballast of each track; 0.762 m is a common assumption, not a rule.

rules.title: Minimum haunch
rules.statement: No source in hand sets a minimum haunch; the documented 300 mm (RCR-VAL-008) is unverified.

rules.title: Minimum earth cushion
rules.statement: No source in hand sets a minimum cushion or its datum; the documented 75 mm (RCR-VAL-007) is unverified.

rules.title: Girder depth / span
rules.statement: Depth ≥ L/20 (documented) against depth ≥ L/12 plate girder, L/20 being a spacing ratio (secondary).

rules.title: Rail above formation
rules.statement: The rail sits on the formation: rail level above formation level.

rules.title: Formation not below the top of a buried structure
rules.statement: A box or pipe is under the formation: formation level ≥ top of the structure (cushion ≥ 0).

rules.title: Top of structure above soffit above floor above underside
rules.statement: top of the top slab > soffit > floor > underside of the bottom slab.
rules.check: gt(top_slab_level, soffit_level) * gt(soffit_level, floor_level) * gt(floor_level, slab_bottom_level)

rules.title: HFL not below the bed
rules.statement: A flood level is at or above the bed.

rules.title: Foundation below the bed
rules.statement: The bottom of the foundation is below the bed.
